definitions.explanation: The side of an object or surface that faces downward or is positioned below another part.

examples.english: Look at the underside of the box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下側|したがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ほこり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溜|た}まっていた→溜まる：02067_tamaru⟧。
examples.english: Dust had accumulated on the underside of the shelf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下側|したがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{亀裂|きれつ}→亀裂：09411_kiretsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていない→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{定期|ていき}{的|てき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It is necessary to regularly inspect the underside of the bridge for cracks.

notes:
Refers to the lower surface or the part underneath something. Formed from ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧ (below) and ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side). Used when specifying which side of an object you mean, often in contexts involving inspection, cleaning, or spatial description.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下側|したがわ}: underside of a desk
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下側|したがわ}: underside of a car
- {下側|したがわ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look from below
- {下側|したがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to stick on the underside

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上側|うわがわ}: upper side — the opposite direction
- ⟦{裏側|うらがわ}→裏側：03042_uragawa⟧: back side, reverse — refers to the hidden face rather than specifically the lower one
- ⟦{底|そこ}→底：12560_soko⟧: bottom — the very lowest surface, not a "side"
